items.text: Malik Nabers active; start wherever rostered despite decoy risk.
items.why: Officially active after murky knee status; elevated practice squad WRs.
items.implication: Start with upside; monitor usage for decoy.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets if full go.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love is ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as Cards wouldn't activate if worried about ankle.
items.why: Active after ankle sprain; expected and played with TD in debut.
items.implication: Start as RB2/flex with risk; role expansion possible ROS.
items.opportunity: Carries + routes as primary back shared with Allgeier.

items.text: Alvin Kamara not expected to play (knee/MCL); inactive. Status affects Travis Etienne projection.
items.why: Full practice late week but not quite ready; cautious after MCL sprain.
items.implication: Etienne lead back; Kamara likely Week 2 return.

items.text: Combine Flowers/McConkey/Thomas/Murray/etc exits with Bowers/AJB/Darnold/Stribling; not a clean injury start.
items.why: Multiple early exits and pre-game outs.
items.implication: Monitor all for Week 2; handcuffs/backups rise.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early after big game; watching with MRI Monday, questionable Week 2.
items.implication: Monitor MRI; Bateman/Likely upside if sits.
items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely and other BAL WRs routes/targets.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest) left early after hit; no immediate update, watching.
items.implication: Week 2 status TBD; Johnston/others benefit short-term.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out with fractured wrist; several weeks, further testing/MRI.
items.why: Fractured wrist in win over Colts.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; depth WRs elevated.

items.text: AJ Brown high-ankle sprain: no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks (IR).
items.why: High ankle; X-rays clean, MRI confirmed no surgery.
items.implication: Miss Weeks 2-5+; stash IR. Patriots WR depth up.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other NE WRs/TE.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially active (calf).
items.why: Expected to play per weekend reports; cleared.
items.implication: Full WR role in high-scoring Bears offense.

items.text: After meniscus trim, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus trim Tuesday; team optimistic short absence.
items.implication: Hold; Mayer TE1 short-term. Check Week 2 practice.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN well under way.
items.why: Strong Week 1 production amid Ravens WR injuries.

items.text: In cash lineup took floor from Ja'Marr Chase but got onto Jonathan Taylor at RB2; process detailed free.
items.why: Floor game Chase; Taylor RB2 value.
items.implication: Prefer safe floors in cash; Taylor strong start.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want as much Bears offense as possible despite Week 1.
items.why: Preseason belief intact; Week 1 weirdness with Kmet/Raymond.
items.implication: Buy-low trade target; Bears TE upside.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason hype with new OC Sean Mannion.
items.why: Preseason talk confirmed in Week 1 role.
items.implication: Roster/start in deeper leagues; PHI WR upside.
